title: sonic-buildimage for broadcom fails arista pytest but images seem OK
author: chrispsommers
body:
#### Description
When building broadcom images, `make` results in pytest failure. Runing make a second time results in brief output and no failure (presumably because image builds and pytests don't get run again.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. make init
2. make configure PLATFORM=broadcom
3. make all

#### Git commit
```
~/sonic/sonic-buildimage$ git log
commit c7cc4b465b9ff1a630c669db1a523fc7d37d0d17 (HEAD -> master, origin/master, origin/HEAD)
Author: Volodymyr Samotiy <volodymyrs@nvidia.com>
Date:   Tue Mar 23 03:27:36 2021 +0200

```

@chrispsommers

Thank you for raising this issue. It is indeed just a testing issue. Arista will fix it in our repo, then update sonic-buildimage with the fix at a later date.

linkedPullRequests.title: [Arista] Update platform drivers submodules
linkedPullRequests.author: Staphylo
linkedPullRequests.body:
- Fix build issue when `/proc/cmdline` is not available. Fixes #7145
 - Properly detect linecard slot from linecard CPU
 - Some fixes on the uart link between supervisor and linecard CPU
 - Other small fixes
